name: Nuoro (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of blue and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Nuoro (a sun above an ox on a mountain) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Nuoro, a comune in Sardinia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Nuoro arms — sun above an ox on a mountain, crowned, within branches
